{{Top|leg}}
A '''survey datapad''' was a type of [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] specially adapted to record survey data collected by [[Scout/Legends|scouts]]. It was a flat [[Computer/Legends|computer]] that could be coupled to a special [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] array to record accurate geographical information as the scout moved across uncharted terrain by bouncing [[Electromagnet/Legends|electromagnetic]] rays off a [[Scout ship/Legends|scout vessel]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. The mapping features of the datapad were also uninterrupted by the scout using it to call up preloaded encyclopedic information.
